## Active-play share (#46)

Active-play share is `(flagship unloads + contract rewards) / all income`, all income being flagship + drones + haulers + contracts. Contract rewards count as active play because the player earns them by mining, breaking and delivering; haulers (miner skims and outpost output, #39) count as idle play alongside drones. Target: **≥ 40% through the mid-game** (systems 3–6).

- Mid-game pooled (income-weighted, 40 seed-warps): **61%** (flagship 47% · drones 35% · haulers 4% · contracts 14%) — **PASS**
- Mid-game across seed-warps: median 62%, 44%–85%
- Per system (median, min–max): 3: 60% (48%–80%) · 4: 66% (49%–85%) · 5: 59% (44%–67%) · 6: 65% (53%–72%)
